- **Tech Blue (`#00B0E4`):** Focused interactive elements, active border rings, key link underlines, terminal accents, and API method badges. *Usage constraint:* Tech Blue is prohibited for body text against white backgrounds to preserve WCAG AAA contrast compliance; use Corporate Navy or `#007A9E` for dark-on-light links when contrast requires.

## Brand & Style

The design system establishes a high-precision, technical editorial aesthetic for Dutch electric vehicle charging infrastructure documentation. The visual language balances institutional Dutch civil engineering authority with state-of-the-art digital documentation design (analogous to high-grade technical manuals, Stripe Docs, and GitBook). 

The target audience encompasses municipal infrastructure planners, grid operators (netbeheerders), EV hardware installers, and mobility software engineers. The interface communicates rigorous clarity, engineering reliability, and institutional trust. 

Design pillars:
- **Utilitarian Editorialism:** Layouts emphasize information architecture, disciplined typographic contrast, and deliberate reading cadence over decorative flair.
- **Structural Precision:** Crisp 1px rule lines and calibrated borders establish spatial hierarchy; layout relies on precise alignment rather than floating elevations.
- **Zero Distraction:** Absolutely no decorative color gradients, whimsical illustrations, or emoji-based visual shortcuts. Visual cues rely on standard technical iconography and semantic status pills.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout employs an asymmetric 3-column reference architecture typical of high-end API and engineering documentation.

### Desktop Three-Column Grid
1. **Left Sidebar (Navigation Tree):** Fixed-width `280px`, sticky viewport height, containing expandable documentation sections, protocol guides, and hardware classifications. Bordered right with 1px `#E2E8F0`.
2. **Central Content Area (Editorial Column):** Fluid width with an absolute internal maximum measure of `66ch` (approx. `760px`) for long-form prose and specifications.
3. **Right Sidebar (On-This-Page / TOC & Metadata):** Fixed-width `240px` displaying dynamic heading anchors, related spec links, and versioning tags.

### Breakpoints & Adaptive Flow
- **Desktop (≥ 1280px):** Full 3-column view active.
- **Tablet / Laptop (1024px – 1279px):** Right Table-of-Contents moves to an in-line collapsed drawer beneath the page title; left navigation remains sticky.
- **Mobile (< 1024px):** Single-column layout. The left navigation collapses into a persistent top search-and-menu header. Margins compress from `2rem` to `1rem`. Reading column spans 100% viewport width minus gutters.

## Elevation & Depth

This design system eschews floating cards and heavy dropshadows in favor of architectural surface division and hairline precision.

- **Primary Elevation (Flat Structural):** Depth is communicated via background distinction (`#FFFFFF` main article versus `#F2F5F8` peripheral navigation) separated by 1px solid borders in `#E2E8F0` or `#D1D9E2`.
- **Micro-Shadows (Functional Elevation):** Shadows are permitted exclusively for transient overlays (interactive search modals, dropdown autocompletes, tooltip flyouts):
  - `box-shadow: 0 4px 16px -2px rgba(12, 35, 64, 0.08), 0 1px 3px rgba(12, 35, 64, 0.04);`
- **Code Panels & Hardware Diagrams:** Framed in a single-pixel outline `#D1D9E2` with a dark `#0A1628` background for syntax blocks. Header bars inside code panels are delineated by an internal hairline border.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary:** Solid `#0C2340` background, pure white text, `6px` border-radius, font: `Inter`, weight 600, 13px size. Hover state shifts to `#163A66`.
- **Secondary / Outline:** `#FFFFFF` background, `#0C2340` text, 1px solid border `#D1D9E2`. Hover state applies `#F2F5F8` background with `#0C2340` border.
- **Tertiary / Utility:** Transparent background, `#0C2340` text. Hover adds `#F2F5F8` background.

### Status Badges & Chips
- **Operational / Active (Eco Green):** Background `#84BD00` with 12% opacity (`rgba(132, 189, 0, 0.12)`), text `#466300`, border 1px solid `rgba(132, 189, 0, 0.3)`. Features an optional 6px solid green dot.
- **Protocol / Technical Meta (Tech Blue):** Background `rgba(0, 176, 228, 0.1)`, text `#007A9E`, border 1px solid `rgba(0, 176, 228, 0.25)`.
- **Draft / In-Review:** Background `#F2F5F8`, text `#475569`, border 1px solid `#E2E8F0`.

### Navigation Tree Lists (Sidebar)
- Structured vertical list with hairline vertical indentation guide lines (1px `#E2E8F0`).
- Link items styled at `14px`, 400 weight, `#475569` color.
- Active page link styled at 600 weight, `#0C2340` text, accompanied by a 2px solid `#00B0E4` left indicator bar positioned against the sidebar guide line.

### Code Display & Terminal Blocks
- Shell container: Background `#0A1628`, border 1px solid `#1E293B`, radius `6px`.
- Code header: Substrate `#0F2038`, 1px bottom border `#1E293B`, contains language badge, filename, and a 1-click copy button.
- Syntax typography: `JetBrains Mono`, `13.5px`, lines numbered with low-contrast muted counters (`#475569`).

### Parameter & Specification Tables
- Full-width structural tables with zero outer elevation.
- Header row: Mist background `#F2F5F8`, uppercase 11px JetBrains Mono labels, 1px bottom border `#D1D9E2`.
- Data rows: Alternating or white surface with 1px horizontal dividers `#E2E8F0`. Parameter names styled in `JetBrains Mono` bold; descriptions in standard `Inter`.

### Form Fields & Inputs
- Height `38px`, 1px border `#D1D9E2`, white background, `6px` radius.
- Focus state: Replaces outline with a precise 1px border `#00B0E4` and a 2px semi-transparent ring `rgba(0, 176, 228, 0.2)`. No fuzzy glow effects.

## Brand & Style

The design system establishes a high-precision, technical editorial aesthetic for Dutch electric vehicle charging infrastructure documentation. The visual language balances institutional Dutch civil engineering authority with state-of-the-art digital documentation design (analogous to high-grade technical manuals, Stripe Docs, and GitBook). 

The target audience encompasses municipal infrastructure planners, grid operators (netbeheerders), EV hardware installers, and mobility software engineers. The interface communicates rigorous clarity, engineering reliability, and institutional trust. 

Design pillars:
- **Utilitarian Editorialism:** Layouts emphasize information architecture, disciplined typographic contrast, and deliberate reading cadence over decorative flair.
- **Structural Precision:** Crisp 1px rule lines and calibrated borders establish spatial hierarchy; layout relies on precise alignment rather than floating elevations.
- **Zero Distraction:** Absolutely no decorative color gradients, whimsical illustrations, or emoji-based visual shortcuts. Visual cues rely on standard technical iconography and semantic status pills.

## Colors

The palette derives from civil energy systems, combining heavy nautical/corporate navy with high-visibility technical accents and clean substrate neutrals.

### Surface & Canvas Tokens
- **Canvas Base (Light):** `#FFFFFF` for primary editorial reading zones to maximize readability.
- **Canvas Muted / Sidebar Substrate:** `#F2F5F8` (Mist) for auxiliary navigation sidebars, table headers, in-line code blocks, and tertiary parameter callouts.
- **Dark Mode Base Canvas:** `#0A1628` paired with elevated panel surfaces of `#102038`.

### Core Brand & Semantic Colors
- **Corporate Navy (`#0C2340`):** Primary text, high-emphasis headings, active tree navigation states, and primary button fills. In dark mode, replaced by `#F8FAFC` for headline typography and `#E2E8F0` for body copy.
- **Tech Blue (`#00B0E4`):** Focused interactive elements, active border rings, key link underlines, terminal accents, and API method badges. *Usage constraint:* Tech Blue is prohibited for body text against white backgrounds to preserve WCAG AAA contrast compliance; use Corporate Navy or `#007A9E` for dark-on-light links when contrast requires.
- **Eco Green (`#84BD00`):** Reserved strictly for operational states, live hardware statuses, and validation success badges. Used sparingly as an indicator, never as decorative background wash.
- **Border Subtle (`#E2E8F0` / `#D1D9E2`):** 1px structural hair-lines defining content columns, table grids, code container headers, and persistent navigational splitters.

## Typography

The typographical structure is engineered for high-density documentation, protocol specifications (e.g., OCPP, ISO 15118), and grid capacity charts.

- **Primary Heading Face (Archivo):** Selected for its geometric discipline, architectural verticality, and industrial authority. Headings feature tight tracking to anchor technical content sections.
- **Reading Body Face (Inter):** Highly legible screen workhorse calibrated for comfortable long-form scanning. Provides superior distinction between numbers, punctuation, and technical terms.
- **Code & Metadata Face (JetBrains Mono):** Applied to terminal outputs, JSON payload definitions, hardware schema parameters, spec tables, and file paths.

### Editorial Hierarchy Directives
- **Measure Rule:** All primary prose body elements (`p`, `ul`, `ol`) are strictly constrained to a maximum width of `66ch` to preserve optical reading flow without user eye fatigue.
- **Paragraph Spacing:** Do not rely on indentation. Separate editorial blocks with clear vertical margin (`1.25rem` below paragraphs).
- **Sub-headings (H2, H3):** Include automatic anchor links on hover for deep-linking across sections.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout employs an asymmetric 3-column reference architecture typical of high-end API and engineering documentation.

### Desktop Three-Column Grid
1. **Left Sidebar (Navigation Tree):** Fixed-width `280px`, sticky viewport height, containing expandable documentation sections, protocol guides, and hardware classifications. Bordered right with 1px `#E2E8F0`.
2. **Central Content Area (Editorial Column):** Fluid width with an absolute internal maximum measure of `66ch` (approx. `760px`) for long-form prose and specifications.
3. **Right Sidebar (On-This-Page / TOC & Metadata):** Fixed-width `240px` displaying dynamic heading anchors, related spec links, and versioning tags.

### Breakpoints & Adaptive Flow
- **Desktop (≥ 1280px):** Full 3-column view active.
- **Tablet / Laptop (1024px – 1279px):** Right Table-of-Contents moves to an in-line collapsed drawer beneath the page title; left navigation remains sticky.
- **Mobile (< 1024px):** Single-column layout. The left navigation collapses into a persistent top search-and-menu header. Margins compress from `2rem` to `1rem`. Reading column spans 100% viewport width minus gutters.

## Elevation & Depth

This design system eschews floating cards and heavy dropshadows in favor of architectural surface division and hairline precision.

- **Primary Elevation (Flat Structural):** Depth is communicated via background distinction (`#FFFFFF` main article versus `#F2F5F8` peripheral navigation) separated by 1px solid borders in `#E2E8F0` or `#D1D9E2`.
- **Micro-Shadows (Functional Elevation):** Shadows are permitted exclusively for transient overlays (interactive search modals, dropdown autocompletes, tooltip flyouts):
  - `box-shadow: 0 4px 16px -2px rgba(12, 35, 64, 0.08), 0 1px 3px rgba(12, 35, 64, 0.04);`
- **Code Panels & Hardware Diagrams:** Framed in a single-pixel outline `#D1D9E2` with a dark `#0A1628` background for syntax blocks. Header bars inside code panels are delineated by an internal hairline border.

## Shapes

The shape vocabulary maintains strict geometric restraint.

- **Standard Elements (Inputs, Buttons, Cards, Banners):** Use `6px` radius (`rounded` token at scale level 1) to convey engineered rigor without aggressive sharp-corner harshness.
- **Sub-elements (Badges, Status Chips, Inline Code Snippets):** Use `4px` radius for tight, crisp bounding boxes.
- **Prohibited:** Completely circular pill buttons (`rounded-full`) are strictly forbidden for action elements and containers, with the sole exception of a 6px status dot indicator.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary:** Solid `#0C2340` background, pure white text, `6px` border-radius, font: `Inter`, weight 600, 13px size. Hover state shifts to `#163A66`.
- **Secondary / Outline:** `#FFFFFF` background, `#0C2340` text, 1px solid border `#D1D9E2`. Hover state applies `#F2F5F8` background with `#0C2340` border.
- **Tertiary / Utility:** Transparent background, `#0C2340` text. Hover adds `#F2F5F8` background.

### Status Badges & Chips
- **Operational / Active (Eco Green):** Background `#84BD00` with 12% opacity (`rgba(132, 189, 0, 0.12)`), text `#466300`, border 1px solid `rgba(132, 189, 0, 0.3)`. Features an optional 6px solid green dot.
- **Protocol / Technical Meta (Tech Blue):** Background `rgba(0, 176, 228, 0.1)`, text `#007A9E`, border 1px solid `rgba(0, 176, 228, 0.25)`.
- **Draft / In-Review:** Background `#F2F5F8`, text `#475569`, border 1px solid `#E2E8F0`.

### Navigation Tree Lists (Sidebar)
- Structured vertical list with hairline vertical indentation guide lines (1px `#E2E8F0`).
- Link items styled at `14px`, 400 weight, `#475569` color.
- Active page link styled at 600 weight, `#0C2340` text, accompanied by a 2px solid `#00B0E4` left indicator bar positioned against the sidebar guide line.

### Code Display & Terminal Blocks
- Shell container: Background `#0A1628`, border 1px solid `#1E293B`, radius `6px`.
- Code header: Substrate `#0F2038`, 1px bottom border `#1E293B`, contains language badge, filename, and a 1-click copy button.
- Syntax typography: `JetBrains Mono`, `13.5px`, lines numbered with low-contrast muted counters (`#475569`).

### Parameter & Specification Tables
- Full-width structural tables with zero outer elevation.
- Header row: Mist background `#F2F5F8`, uppercase 11px JetBrains Mono labels, 1px bottom border `#D1D9E2`.
- Data rows: Alternating or white surface with 1px horizontal dividers `#E2E8F0`. Parameter names styled in `JetBrains Mono` bold; descriptions in standard `Inter`.

### Form Fields & Inputs
- Height `38px`, 1px border `#D1D9E2`, white background, `6px` radius.
- Focus state: Replaces outline with a precise 1px border `#00B0E4` and a 2px semi-transparent ring `rgba(0, 176, 228, 0.2)`. No fuzzy glow effects.
